title: Static Clothed Upright Torso And Curled Fan Tail Merfolk
description: One independently authored complete static clothed merfolk fantasy character. A continuous fully covered tunic waist, upright chest, neck and human-like head rises directly from a newly drawn single broad fish lower body. The whole lower body curves down and sideways into a tapered raised tailstock and a thick complete bifurcated fan fin, with a finite low tail-underside resting patch. Two complete long-sleeved bent arms and blunt hands frame the waist; integral dark hair regions, small embedded eyes, ears and a blunt nose define a simple adult-like stylized face. All body sections, curve paths, fin outline and limb placements are new numeric geometry, not a catalog fish with a human head, the existing centaur upper body pasted onto a fish, or a horse with its legs removed. No old mesh or character coordinates are imported. Four opaque untextured PBR materials, one character model zero scenes, metres Z up and full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Entire torso and arms clothed; no weapon, equipment, extra costume asset or realistic anatomy claim. Static fictional art only, no biology, swimming, balance, skin deformation, articulation, rig, animation, interaction, collision or safety validation.
